review.assessment:
The change replaces the hardcoded KB scaling with a sequential loop that divides by 1024 to step through units (KB through PB), stopping early when the scaled value drops below 1024 or hits PB. It also formats all scaled outputs to exactly one decimal place as requested, preserving the base `< 1024` byte case. This correctly implements scaling up to petabytes without requiring manual branching for each unit.

Findings: none.
